special_rules.title: Minimum holding time

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 評価は口座資金の1%以上の利益日が3日必要。ファンデッドは日本語FAQと英語FAQで条件が異なります。日本語FAQ：最低3取引日。追加ルール記事13645541は「ライト（1ステップ・2ステップ）の5,000万円口座は標準の3日」と記載（サイトの$300K列は日本語FAQの5,000万円口座に、口座サイズの並び順で対応させた推定。公式の換算表示はない）。1日単位でも全体でも利益目標なし。英語FAQ（2026-10-08頃改定）：前回出金以降、確定損益が1%以上の日が5日（$300K口座は5日）。どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: Evaluation: three profitable days ≥1% of account size. Funded: the Japanese and English FAQs differ. Japanese FAQ: minimum 3 trading days; additional-rules article 13645541 states that LITE (1-Step and 2-Step) ¥50M accounts keep the standard 3 days (the site's $300K column is matched to the Japanese FAQ's ¥50M account by size order; FundedElite publishes no conversion). No daily or overall profit target. English FAQ (revised around 8 Oct 2026): 5 days with closed P&L ≥1% since the last payout ($300K accounts need 5 days). consistency.text_ja: 日本語FAQ：ファンデッド口座に一貫性35%（評価フェーズは対象外。一貫性ルール記事17462703の対象：フラッシュ、即時チャレンジ（有効選択時）、ライト1/2ステップ、1/2ステップ、5,000万円口座。追加ルール記事13645541にも「すべてのファンデッド口座に適用」と記載。公式Xの2026-10-13告知は提出者確認）。英語FAQ：$300K口座は60%。日本語版と英語版で異なり、どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
consistency.text_en: Japanese FAQ: 35% consistency on funded accounts (not in evaluation; consistency article 17462703 lists Flash, Instant when enabled, LITE 1/2-Step, 1/2-Step and ¥50M accounts; additional-rules article 13645541 also says all funded accounts; the 13 Oct 2026 official X post is per the submitter). special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

price.text_ja: 掲載価格 USD 899（購入時に公式で確認）
price.text_en: Listed price USD 899 (confirm officially at purchase)

ea.text_ja: 手動戦略のリスク・数量管理、分析等の補助のみ。独立発注や全部/一部自動売買は禁止。未申告EAは停止対象。
ea.text_en: Only support for manual strategies, such as risk/size management or analysis. Independent order entry or fully/partly automated trading prohibited. Undeclared EAs may cause suspension.

copy.text_ja: 自己/他者口座のコピーには明示の許可が必要。
copy.text_en: Express permission required to copy own/others' accounts.

vps.text_ja: VPN/VPSは事前通知し、IPと口座の関連を伝える条件で利用可能。
vps.text_en: VPN/VPS allowed with prior notice and disclosure of the IP/account relationship.

ip.text_ja: 旅行も事前通知と航空券・予約等の証拠が必要。未通知利用はsoft breachの対象。
ip.text_en: Travel requires prior notice and evidence such as tickets/reservations. Unnotified use may be a soft breach.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 5利益日。各日の最低利益は25KでUSD150、50KでUSD250。上位段階は別。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: Five profitable days. Minimum per day: USD150 for 25K, USD250 for 50K. Higher stages differ.

profit_share.text_ja: 開始80%。最上位1M段階95%。
profit_share.text_en: Starts at 80%; top 1M level 95%.

consistency.text_ja: 英語FAQ：30%、購入時に解除可。日本語FAQにCatalystの記事はなく、日本語の一貫性ルール記事（17462703）の対象一覧にも含まれない。日本語版の扱いは未確認。
consistency.text_en: English FAQ: 30%, removable at checkout. The Japanese FAQ has no Catalyst article and the Japanese consistency article (17462703) does not list it; the Japanese-version treatment is unverified.

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).
